request.text: Before the call, remind me to send it to her.

responsibilities.outcome: Ask the user to identify the intended recipient, what must be sent, and which call or concrete reminder time they mean before attempting to create the reminder.

interpretation_unresolved: call identity and schedulable reminder time

semantic_facts: The request lacks a grounded recipient, item to send, and schedulable interpretation of ‘before the call,’ so the planner must seek user-resolvable clarification.
Clarification should obtain the missing arguments without guessing them or creating an executable partial reminder.
forbidden_claims: The planner invents who ‘her’ is, what ‘it’ denotes, which call is intended, or a reminder time.
The planner claims that a reminder was created despite unresolved required arguments.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Missing required arguments are filled from unsupported defaults or imagined conversational context.
The reminder capability is invoked with partial parameters instead of requesting one genuine clarification covering the unresolved fields.
